merchant_emulated_device_timing.scope: Additional 60 simulated seconds after 120 seconds in the closed merchant; matched snapshot and flash, cumulative ROOM B minus A after ordinary OS exit. Minima/maxima are deliberately not subtracted. This is Firebird emulated-device timing, not physical-device FPS.

failed_or_excluded_attempts.reason: The offline adapter rejected a 288-sample source request at its old 256 cap; bounded cap512 preserves one continuous source integration.
A partially transparent Regent eye could not be flattened safely into Normal. Original ordered emission is retained in one image per frame.
The source has an additional Normal sweat slot in 62 of 320 samples. The converter now validates identity/material/order with actual visibility.

The old resource test requested drawable pixels for explicit non-raster kerning metadata. All ordinary glyph bytes remain compared, and every metadata pair now has an independent numeric layout oracle.

Original foreground has 11 distinct LCD images across 144 source samples. Exact independently reconstructed per-sequence counts replace the arbitrary density threshold while retaining all 1800 frames.
The old speech-lifetime comparison treated an independently animated room background as static. The test-only same-clock background oracle preserves all speech/input assertions.
Short old-runtime navigation was not observed before USB retrieval; screenshot remained Settings. Interrupted invalid attempt, no performance result accepted.
The earlier 136/137 run exposed a real finished-FakeMerchant Detail leak. Its production correction is in final runtime 792; final registered native 137/137 is counted once.
Earlier cp17 323 unique is historical; final cp18 is 271 + 56 - 2 = 325. Do not sum historical runs or repeated prune tests.

acceptance_limits: Registered native/Python tests, native pixel checks and emulated-device timing are distinct scopes.
Room fight outcomes labelled as controlled fixtures do not establish natural victories.
Merchant timing is a paired warm cumulative-counter delta; no minimum or maximum values were subtracted.
No physical calculator FPS or blanket desktop-GPU equivalence claim is made.
All prior failed/unknown attempts remain excluded from successful gate totals.
Default 78,569,446-byte install remains above the rough 65–70 MB target; no further quality, frame or clock reduction was used to hide this.
Natural device acceptance covers a fresh first battle and save/Continue cycle; the four special-room cases are explicitly controlled fixtures.
Final installation acceptance uses the independent closed cp17-release-restore-f7c4994628da session, not successful substeps of the earlier failed USB-link session.
